name: Chile
notes: Seed research in progress; local and regional sources have not been systematically searched. Geography covers 16 regions and 346 comunas. The BCN/OCHA 2020 map has 345 shapes; Antártica has no shape. Pozo Almonte was mislabeled Tocopilla in the source and matched by location and CUT. Boundaries are simplified; source notes topology defects.

polls.scope: Chile, adults 18 and over in 166 comunas, online panel
polls.question: Agreement with Congress approving a tax of 2.5% on the net wealth of people with US$ 22 million or more, to fund the response to the covid-19 crisis (the 'súper ricos' bill); 82.9% strongly agreed or agreed
polls.question_original: ¿Qué tan de acuerdo o en desacuerdo estás con que se apruebe en el congreso un impuesto a los super ricos?
polls.commissioned_by: Activa (its own fortnightly Pulso Ciudadano tracker)
polls.sample: 1,184 interviews, non-probability online panel, margin of error +/- 2.8%
